narrative: The market is currently navigating a risk-off environment as the Nasdaq 100 enters technical correction territory amid cooling enthusiasm for AI valuations. Investors are focused on the US Midterm elections, where a projected Democratic sweep of Congress raises concerns about fiscal gridlock and corporate investigations. While Goldman Sachs sees a long-term tech super cycle, immediate sentiment is weighed down by Apple's margin guidance and high multiples for AI-linked stocks like Palantir. Geopolitical tensions remain a factor with US strikes on Iran, though diplomatic signals from the Trump administration are providing a counter-narrative for energy markets.

Nasdaq.why: The index has entered technical correction territory as AI multiples are viewed as overvalued and Apple issued disappointing gross margin guidance.

S&P 500.why: Investors are maintaining a 'wait and see' stance pending the outcome of the US Midterm elections and upcoming JOLTS labor data.

Gold.why: Prices are hovering near one-year lows as Ed Yardeni warns of increased political partisanship and potential debt crises.

Oil.why: Traders are balancing military strikes on Qeshm Island against signals from Trump and Vance regarding a potential diplomatic settlement with Iran.
